newsitem.title: USA: Magellan to buy Aetna unit for $122.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Magellan to buy Aetna unit for $122.1 mln.

text.p: Magellan Health Services Inc said it signed a definitive agreement to buy Human Affairs International Inc (HAI) from Aetna Inc's health business unit for $122.1 million in cash.
Magellan also said it entered into a long-term behavorial health strategic relationship with Aetna U.S. Healthcare, under which it may pay Aetna up to $300 million over the length of the deal.
Magellan did not say how long the strategic relationship would last and officials there were not immediately available to comment.
Officials at Aetna were not immediately available.
HAI provides behavioral health programs to about 15.0 million people, most of whom are Aetna U.S. Healthcare members.
The acquisition brings the number of people for whom Magellan manages behavioral care and employee assistance programs to about 32.0 million, Magellan said.
Magellan said the acquisition will be accounted as a purchase, and is expected to close in this year's fourth quarter.
